screens.permissionBoundary: Per-operation permissions are conjunctive; surface permission union is discovery metadata, never an all-or-any authorization rule. Unknown is denied.
screens.behavior: Draft/unpublished submit; in_review approve; approved future schedule; approved/scheduled publish; published unpublish. No client If-Match or expected-version support; current/published version pointers differ.
screens.readBoundary: Only traced authorized reads and returned safe metadata. Collection caps are not totals. Blocked operations expose no data. No inferred customer history, promotion picker, AI job, audit endpoint or cross-domain privilege.
